description: E5+E6 with the execution credential: the shared MCP server, K sessions, automatic binding; the runtime switches the identity with prctl(PR_FACT), the BPF LSM authorizes the switch and keeps the credential per task (inherited at clone), and the egress policy (cgroup/connect4) decides by the credential. Executions alternate a permissive (P) and a restricted (R) class; independent reference via the exclusive port. Attribution is scored from the accepted switches (collector fact-cred.bt) and the decisions from the kernel's own records.
